title: 7th Bolu International Poster Design Competition (BIAH)
description: Design a sustainable future poster on the Beyond Horizons theme. Open to designers worldwide with no submission limit.
descriptionDetailed: Designers everywhere interpret Beyond Horizons: Designing a Sustainable Future through posters aligned with five UN Sustainable Development Goals. Selected works are exhibited in December 2026, all exhibited designers receive a digital certificate, and the top three earn the BIAH Achievement Certificate. Free to enter, with no limit on submissions.

prize.description: All exhibited designers receive a digital certificate of participation. The top three works receive the symbolic digital BIAH Achievement Certificate, and the first-place winner earns the right to serve as a jury member at the next BIAH event.

audience.eligibilityDetail: Participation is open to everyone; posters must relate to the theme and be written in English or English plus the participant's native language.
